05 / MAKING · PROCESSING

How we do.

From background research to a live environment: music, images

and physical space are developed as one connected process.

01 / RESEARCH

Listen. Locate. Connect.

Research the music and venue, selecting a shared atmosphere and

visual narrative.

02 / IMAGE & SPACE

Build the visual world.

Produce moving-image sequences and arrange the gauze surfaces. The

visual library and the physical installation develop together.

03 / LIVE PERFORMANCE

Bring the system to life.

Scene selection and transitions follow the performance. The proposal

also explores music-panel and sensor input for real-time interaction.

RESEARCH → GENERATION → CONSTRUCTION → PERFORMANCE
